suggestions.evidence: Rescan 823.9-826.1 (the 2.8s gap between Onix and Zinnia's Trust): Enamorus 48 Uncommon top in 68% of frames, peak 0.814, near-tie with Enamorus 110 IR (0.805, same art). Position is slot 5, which only allows an Uncommon, so it's 48. check_fit passes (slot 5).
Rescan 930.1-933.4 (in the 7.5s gap before Kommo-o): two cards held together. Nidoran♀ 55 peak 0.825, top in 33% of frames. Fits slot 8 as a reverse holo.

Same stretch 930.1-933.4: Tornadus 85 peak 0.806, top in 33% of frames. Detection had merged this as a repeat showing at 931.2 of the slot-5 Tornadus. The layout needs a second card in slots 8-9, so this is a second copy as a reverse holo in slot 9. check_fit passes together with Nidoran♀.

notes: Pack 1 is marked probably_not_a_pack, so I skipped it. Pack 9 is complete with Enamorus 48 (slot 5); Mega Rayquaza Cap, Kecleon IR and Arcanine take slots 8-10. Pack 10 is complete with Nidoran♀ and a second Tornadus as reverse holos in slots 8-9. Side note: pack 10's existing Legendary Trench 99 at 920s barely leads Legendary Summit 97 (lead 0.005). It may be worth checking during review.
